paite: Israel, a gah suah jel, grepgui pha ahi; a gah tam mahmah dungjuiin a maitamte a pungsak; a gam hoihna dungjuiin kham kilawm taktak a bawl uh.
english: Israel is a luxuriant vine that puts forth his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.

paite: A lungtang uh a kikhena; huchiin mohtansakin a om ding uh; a maitamte uh a sat dinga, a khuamte uh a lok ding hi.
english: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.

paite: Kumpipa i neikei uh: TOUPA lah i kihta kei ua; kumpipa leng, ei adingin bang a hih thei dia? tuin a chi taktak ding uh.
english: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear Yahweh; and the king, what can he do for us?”

paite: Thukhunte bawlnaa juaua kichiamin, thu bangloute a gen ua; huaijiakin lou lehsaa namtul bangin vaihawm na a pou khe ding.
english: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.

paite: Beth-aven bawngnoute jiakin Samaria tengteng a lau ding ua; huai miten lah a sun ding uhi, huan huaia siampu a tunga kipakte, huai thupi jiakin, amaha, kipana paimang ta ahihjiakin.
english: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven; for its people will mourn over it, Along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.

paite: Kumpipa Jareb kianga thilpiak dinga Assuria lama puak ahi lai ding a Ephraim zahlakna a mu dia, Israel amah pilna ah a zahlak ding.
english: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.

paite: Samari a hihleh a kumpipa satkhiak ahi, tui tunga, tuiphuan bangin.
english: Samaria and her king float away, like a twig on the water.

paite: Aven mun sangte leng, Israel khelhna hihsiat ahi ding: ling leh loulingnei a maitam tunguah a hongkahtou dinga; mualte kiangah, Honsin un; tangte kiangah, honpuk khum un, a chi ding uh.
english: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”

paite: Aw Israel, Gibeah nite akipan na khialta a; huailaiah a ding ua; Gibeah thulimlouhna tate tunga kidounain amaute a phak louhna dingin.
english: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.

paite: Ka hun chiangin, amaute ka sawi ding; a tatlekna uh thuahnih jiaka taihilh a hih hun chiang un, amau dou dingin mite a kikhawm khawm ding uh.
english: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them, when they are bound to their two transgressions.

paite: Huan Ephraim sinsaka om bawngla ahi a, buhlehbal chil khiak ut; himahleh a ngawng kilawm tunga ka pai suaka; Ephraim tungah tungtuangmi ka koih ding; Judain lei a let dia, Jakobin a sai a nawn ding.
english: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.

paite: Diktatna ah kituh unla, chitna bangjelin at un, na leileh lei uh satkham un; a hongpaia na tung ua diktatna a honzuksak tan, TOUPA zon hun lah ahi ngala.
english: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.

paite: Gitlouhna lei na let ua, thulimlouhna na lata uh; huau genna gah na neta ua; na lampi ah, na mi hatte ah lah na muangta ngala.
english: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.

paite: Huaijiakin na mite lakah buaina a hongpawt dinga, na kulhte tuh lohin a om ding, kidou laia Salmanin Beth-arbel a lok bangin; nu a tate toh paih nenin a om ua.Huchibang mahin na gitlouh mahmah jiakin Bethelin na tungah a hih ding: nusiahin Israel kumpipa satkhiak siangin a omta ding hi.
english: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.

paite: Huchibang mahin na gitlouh mahmah jiakin Bethelin na tungah a hih ding: nusiahin Israel kumpipa satkhiak siangin a omta ding hi.
english: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.
